answers.answer: Realistically about ₹3.2 Cr for Q3, not the ₹3.9 Cr the reps are calling. Most of the gap is Priya's single-contact deals (lowered by about half) and Rahul's two deals above ₹50 L. Arjun's pipeline is likely understated by roughly ₹20 L.

Priya's forecasts need the most correction right now: her single-contact deals close about 45% of the time against 90% calls. Sana used to be the least reliable, but she has been close to reality since Q3.

Zenith Logistics has one contact and no finance contact. Priya's deals like that have closed 4 of 9 times, so Calibrate cut her 90% to 50%. Getting a second stakeholder and finance on the next call would change that.
